key_insight: PTME profiling shows that lightweight LLMs can have similar accuracy under different resource envelopes, but their real deployment cost varies substantially in time, memory, and energy.
engineering_relevance: For edge and local deployment, model choice should be based on measured Precision-Time-Memory-Energy tradeoffs rather than proxy metrics like parameters or FLOPs alone.
method: Directly measure Precision, execution Time, peak Memory, and Energy (PTME) during inference
Evaluate multiple lightweight LLMs on code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multi-task understanding
Use Pareto analysis to identify non-dominated model configurations under edge-class resource constraints
evidence_signal: The authors benchmarked lightweight LLMs locally on a controlled desktop platform and found that tighter resource envelopes increased cost without changing precision, with time affected more strongly than energy.
watch_item: Results are based on a controlled desktop setup, so the measured PTME tradeoffs may shift on different hardware, runtimes, or thermal/power management settings.
